application story
Marine solution
Enhancing energy efficiency with 
Marine Digital Management 
solutions
The "Marine Power Management System Market" is set to achieve USD 112.67 Billion by 
2031, propelled by a strong CAGR of 7.48% between 2024 and 2031. Reducing energy 
consumption minimizes greenhouse gas emissions, helping the marine industry align with 
global environmental regulations. Enhancing energy efficiency is critical for mitigating climate 
change and reducing the carbon footprint of vessels. On the other hand, Fuel is one of the 
most significant operational costs in marine management. Energy efficiency directly reduces 
fuel consumption and can lower greenhouse gas emissions and air pollution. Proficient energy 
consumption ensures optimal performance of systems, reduces wear and tear, and enhances 
the reliability and longevity of marine equipment.
Project challenges/goals
Many marine regulations, including the Ship Energy 
Efficiency Management Plan (SEEMP), mandate energy-
efficient practices, making it essential for operators to focus 
on energy savings.
A Nordic solution provider is committed to enhancing 
sustainability within the global maritime industry, 
strengthening its competitive advantage in Energy 
Efficiency Management. The solution digitalizes ferry and vessel information and provides systems with precise know-
how to reduce fuel consumption and greenhouse gas 
emissions. An integrated system solution with HMI, PLC, 
and remote access capabilities is needed to reduce their 
client’s environmental footprint and help the user reach 
energy targets.

www.beijerelectronics.comapplication storySolution overview
To meet the requirements mentioned above, the user 
specializes in creating energy-efficient solutions for vessels. 
They began by remotely monitoring and controlling the 
HVAC systems on the vessels. The CloudVPN gateway is 
invaluable for remote access, allowing engineers to operate 
and troubleshoot remotely, which reduces the need for 
on-site visits. Using the CloudLogging and Dashboard 
features in the CloudVPN portal, the user can intuitively 
view real-time and historical data on energy consumption 
and savings.
In addition to CloudVPN, their standard solutions include 
DNV-certified JetNet unmanaged switches, HMIs, remote 
I/O, and Modular PLC systems, which are offered to their 
customers as a total package.Here is what the user says:
1. "With CloudVPN, we can access our systems remotely via 
VPN for optimization and fault finding."
2. "Using the portal, we get a quick and clear overview of 
the performance (current and historical) of all our systems 
simultaneously while offering our customers the same 
level of access and insight. " (Figure 1, Figure 2, Figure 3)
This solution has enhanced operational efficiency through 
advanced monitoring and optimization technologies, 
resulting in ongoing energy savings for these industry 
giants.

Enhancing energy efficiency with 
Marine Digital Management 
solutions
The "Marine Power Management System Market" is set to achieve USD 112.67 Billion by 
2031, propelled by a strong CAGR of 7.48% between 2024 and 2031. Reducing energy 
consumption minimizes greenhouse gas emissions, helping the marine industry align with 
global environmental regulations. Enhancing energy efficiency is critical for mitigating climate 
change and reducing the carbon footprint of vessels. On the other hand, Fuel is one of the 
most significant operational costs in marine management. Energy efficiency directly reduces 
fuel consumption and can lower greenhouse gas emissions and air pollution. Proficient energy 
consumption ensures optimal performance of systems, reduces wear and tear, and enhances 
the reliability and longevity of marine equipment.
Project challenges/goals
Many marine regulations, including the Ship Energy 
Efficiency Management Plan (SEEMP), mandate energy-
efficient practices, making it essential for operators to focus 
on energy savings.
A Nordic solution provider is committed to enhancing 
sustainability within the global maritime industry, 
strengthening its competitive advantage in Energy 
Efficiency Management. The solution digitalizes ferry and vessel information and provides systems with precise know-
how to reduce fuel consumption and greenhouse gas 
emissions. An integrated system solution with HMI, PLC, 
and remote access capabilities is needed to reduce their 
client’s environmental footprint and help the user reach 
energy targets.
